integrity: The proof is analytic; a Python numerical checker provides reproducibility support only. The general stochastic order characterizations are explicitly credited to their original authors.
scientific_limitations: Threshold is specific to the stated log-Pareto parameterization and to universal-in-intensity compound-Poisson majorization. Post-threshold failure is proved for sufficiently small positive intensities; the un-compounded majorization property is not classified. Independent literature priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Sharp inverted-concavity threshold and compound-Poisson majorization boundary for log-Pareto laws
